positions.name: OwnedIntelligenceThesis
positions.frame: how is the owned-versus-rented intelligence distinction established and self-positioned as a thesis?
positions.why: All three expressions perform one directional read: src-1 and src-2 assert the categorical owned/rented distinction as aphoristic maxims (substrate-as-commodity, perspective-as-asset), and src-3 names that very distinction as 'the individually-owned-intelligence thesis' and positions it for extraction navigation. The set holds a conviction gradient — src-1 and src-2 are unhedged claims, src-3 is notion-level meta-commentary — but the frame reads both sides: the maxims and their self-naming cohere as one thesis being performed and then explicitly positioned.
